sentences.text: 3. At the instance of the report lodged by the lady aged 34 years, the crime has been registered alleging the offence of rape.
It is the informant's contention that her consent was obtained under threat and thus, it is against her will and consent in the eyes of law, and therefore, the offence of rape.
4. Learned Counsel for the applicant would submit that the informant is well grownup married lady having two children.
